Landing.heroSubtitle: A simple prediction game that turns into a real biathlon strategy game.
Landing.featuresEyebrow: Easy to play, rich to master
Landing.f1Title: A simple game: 3 biathletes per race
Landing.f1Body: Before each race, pick 3 biathletes. 30 seconds is all it takes, and you can change your mind until the start.
Landing.f1Pin1: The odds: the higher they are, the more the biathlete earns. Dare to back the outsider?
Landing.f1Pin2: Your 3 picks, that's it. You can pick the same biathletes from one race to the next.
Landing.f1Pin3: Predictions close when the race starts.
Landing.f2Title: You score if your biathletes finish in the Top 10
Landing.f2Body: Each biathlete earns their odds multiplied according to their place. Hundreds of points are at stake in every race.
Landing.f2Pin1: Just like the World Cup, winning pays: odds × 25 for 1st, down to × 1 for 10th.
Landing.f2Pin2: A well-placed outsider earns more than a winning favourite.
Landing.f2Pin3: Bonus if your 3 picks finish in the Top 10 (+20), Top 5 (+50) or on the podium (+100). And +200 for the perfect prediction.
Landing.f3Body: Create your league, share the code and follow your own ranking, on top of the overall standings.
Landing.f3Pin1: A code to send to your friends, family or colleagues so they can join you.
Landing.f3Pin2: Yellow bib for the season leader, red bib for the best player of each stage.
Landing.f3Pin3: You, neck and neck: every race can change everything.
Landing.f4Body: Special stages with bonuses or penalties, bonus cards, World Championships that count double: the standings stay open until the last race.
Landing.f4Pin1: Special races, announced in advance, change the rules: here, every penalty loop costs you points.
Landing.f4Pin2: Score points in 10 races in a row and win a bonus card, to play whenever you choose.
Landing.f4Pin3: The World Championships count double, and you have 3 ×2 boosts to use during the season.
Landing.mockSpecialRule: −20 pts per penalty loop of your biathletes
Landing.faqTitle: Everything to know before the start
Landing.faq_free_a: Yes, 100%. No real money, no cash prizes: you play for fun, glory and the yellow bib.
Landing.faq_account_q: Do I need an account to start?
Landing.faq_account_a: Not right away. Tap "I'm in": the next race opens and you make your picks. You're only asked for an account when you confirm, with a simple code sent by email, no password.
Landing.faq_when_q: Until when can I make or change my picks?
Landing.faq_when_a: Predictions for a stage open one week before it starts. You can change them as often as you like until each race starts, then they're locked.
Landing.faq_points_q: How many points can I win on a race?
Landing.faq_points_a: Hundreds. Each Top 10 biathlete earns their odds multiplied according to their place: × 25 for the winner, × 18 for 2nd… down to × 1 for 10th. Like the World Cup scale, it rewards winning first and foremost. A biathlete with odds of 9 who wins already brings in 225 points, before the Top 10, Top 5, Podium and Perfect prediction bonuses.
Landing.faq_relays_a: Yes. On a relay you pick a nation, and only the top 5 score (odds × 10 for the win). There are fewer points at stake than in individual races, so consistency makes the difference.
Landing.faq_mistakes_q: What if I miss a race or get it wrong?
Landing.faq_mistakes_a: You're allowed mistakes. At the end of the season, your 3 worst individual race results and your 2 worst relays are dropped, starting with the races you didn't play. Only the World Championships and Olympics are never dropped. Jokers only apply to the overall season standings: stage rankings don't change.
Landing.faq_special_a: Some races, announced in advance, have an exceptional rule. Penalty loop: each penalty loop by your biathletes costs 20 points, and a biathlete not picked counts as 5 loops (-100). Fog: a biathlete outside the Top 10 costs you as many points as their place. Busted: penalty if your picks finish outside the Top 10. National Day: biathletes from your favourite team earn double.
Landing.faq_cards_q: How do I win bonus cards?
Landing.faq_cards_a: By scoring points in 10 races in a row, relays included: that's the 10/10. You then pick your card: Boost (×3 on one biathlete), Spare round, Rocket and Trigger (ski and shooting bonuses over a whole stage), Talent (relaunch your Diamond)… Play it at the right time to turn the standings upside down. No cards at the Worlds.
Landing.faq_team_a: Pick your colours for the season, for example France Women or Norway Men, and follow their wins and podiums from your home page. Your team can also earn you points: double on National Day, and with the Team card at the end of the season.
Landing.faq_standings_a: The overall standings add up all your points of the season: the leader wears the yellow bib. After each stage, a stage ranking decides who wears the red bib. And every league has its own ranking.
Landing.faq_worlds_q: Can the standings still change late in the season?
Landing.faq_worlds_a: Yes, and that's the whole point. The World Championships count double, a well-played bonus card can earn big, and the season globes are awarded at the end of the winter. Nothing is decided before the last race.
Landing.finalSubtitle: Pick your 3 biathletes in 30 seconds and join the race for the yellow bib.
Landing.footerDisclaimer: Biathlonpronos is an independent biathlon prediction game. No real money wagered. No financial winnings.

Regles.title: The rules
Regles.subtitle: Everything you need in 5 minutes
Regles.intro: Predict which biathletes will perform, play their odds, use your bonuses at the right time and try to grab the Yellow Bib as the season's best predictor.
Regles.golden2Body: A well-chosen outsider earns more than a favourite.
Regles.golden3Body: A bad weekend is never final.
Regles.pickBody: For each individual race, pick 3 biathletes. The riskier your pick (high odds), the more it can earn, but they must finish in the Top 10. Your prediction locks at the start of the race.
Regles.scaleTitle: Scale: odds × multiplier by finishing place
Regles.comboBody: Your 3 picks together can earn you a bonus on top of their points.
Regles.comboPerfectDesc: The 3 biathletes who scored the most
Regles.oddsBody: Each biathlete has odds for each race format. Favourites have the lowest odds, outsiders the highest: they can earn much more.
Regles.oddsWhen: Odds are reassessed at key moments of the season: Christmas break, end of January, after the World Championships or Olympics.
Regles.pursuitBody: After the sprint, pursuit odds are recalculated automatically: +5 for every 20 s behind the winner. The first 20 s are neutral, and odds are capped at 50.
Regles.pursuitExample: Example: base odds 10, gap in the sprint
Regles.relayBody: You predict a nation instead of 3 biathletes. Only the top 5 nations score, with a lower scale than individual races.
Regles.x2Body: Doubles every point of a prediction, on a World Cup individual race or relay. Not on the World Championships/Olympics or special races.
Regles.worldsBody: Every race of these events automatically counts double. Not stackable with your personal ×2 bonus, and no bonus card can be played there.
Regles.fgBody: Two 10/10 bonus cards that reward the essence of biathlon: skiing and shooting. Play them on a stage before its 1st race and they count in all its individual races. Fixed points (doubled by your ×2 bonus), stackable across your 3 biathletes, even outside the Top 10. Not with Boost, nor at the Worlds/Olympics.
Regles.fuseeDesc: Per biathlete with a top 3 ski time: +100, +50 or +20.
Regles.gachetteDesc: Per biathlete who shoots 20/20 (+50 for a 10/10 in the sprint).
Regles.questionsBody: On some races, answer a question to earn extra points. You can change your answer while it is open.
Regles.questionsBeforeDesc: 2 to 4 answers, on the race page, until the start.
Regles.questionsLiveDesc: 2 answers, open for a few minutes during the race. A notification warns you.
Regles.streakBody: Score points in 10 races in a row (relays included) and win a bonus card of your choice. A race without points resets the counter.
Regles.streakRules: The same card can't be taken twice in a row. {farte} doesn't stack with a ×2 (never ×6), nor with Rocket or Trigger. {farte} can be played during a {fourth}, {aspiration} can't. No cards at the Worlds/Olympics.
Regles.specialIntro: Some races have an exceptional rule, announced in advance. No ×2 bonus on these races.
Regles.penaDesc: Per penalty loop by your biathletes. A biathlete not picked counts as 5 loops (-100 pts).
Regles.fogDesc: Outside the Top 10, a malus equal to the finishing place: 13th = −13 pts, 48th = −48 pts.
Regles.colleDesc: A malus if your picks finish outside the Top 10:
Regles.feteDesc: Your picked biathletes from your favourite team (nation and sex) who finish in the Top 10 score double. Not stackable with another ×2 ({farte} stays at ×3).
Regles.globesBody: Before the season starts, 6 predictions: the overall globe, the best young athlete and the best nation, for women and for men.
Regles.globeBigScale: Overall globe: rewards the final Top 5
Regles.globeSmallScale: Young and nation: reward the podium
Regles.pepiteBody: A bet at the start of the season on one outsider per sex, which other players can't see. It is played secretly on every individual race: on its first Top 10 of the season, the points it earns in that race are added to your race score. It is then revealed (❄️ in the standings) and becomes a regular athlete again. Until it is revealed, you can't include it in your race picks. The Talent card then lets you reactivate it or pick a new one.
Regles.jokersBody: At the end of the season, your worst results are wiped (never the World Championships, the Olympics, or malus and bonus races). A race you didn't play is wiped first. Wiping a result removes its points: a 0 costs nothing.
Regles.jokersPreview: Preview during the season in Standings, “My ranking” box.
Regles.generalBody: Adds up every point of the season. The leader wears the Yellow Bib.
Regles.stageBody: The points of a single stage. Its leader wears the Red Bib, and everyone shows their stage wins.
Regles.leaguesBody: Create your league, share the code and take on your friends in standings of your own.
Regles.finalBody: Pick your 3 biathletes. Watch the shooting. Check the skis. And above all… avoid the penalty loop.

sections.title: 1. Introduction
paragraphs: Biathlonpronos ("the Application") respects its users' privacy. This privacy policy explains what personal data is collected, how it is used, and what your rights are.

sections.title: 2. Data collected
paragraphs: When you use the Application, we collect:
bullets: Predictions, bonus cards and game history
Sign-in data (email and password, or OAuth provider: Google, Apple)

sections.title: 3. Use of data
paragraphs: The data collected is used exclusively to:

Some data may be processed by our technical providers (hosting, database, authentication) strictly to run the service.

RuleInfo.title: How does it work?
RuleInfo.individual: Pick 3 biathletes. Each one scores if they finish in the Top 10: their odds × 25 for a win, × 18 for 2nd place… down to × 1 for 10th. Bonus if your 3 picks all finish in the Top 3, Top 5 or Top 10.
RuleInfo.fusee: Rocket card played on the stage: +100 / +50 / +20 pts per biathlete with the 3 fastest ski times.
RuleInfo.gachette: Trigger card played on the stage: +100 pts per 20/20 shooting, +50 per 10/10 in the sprint.
RuleInfo.pursuitStart: Athletes start in the order of the sprint results, and odds are re-evaluated based on the time gap.
RuleInfo.relay: For relays, pick a single team: it scores if it finishes in the Top 5 (its odds × 10 for a win, then × 6, × 4, × 2 and × 1).
RuleInfo.x2: Until the start, you can change your prediction and activate a ×2 bonus (3 per season).

BonusCards.desc_ca_farte: Keep it in hand: a ×3 on one of your biathletes, on the individual race of your choice.
BonusCards.desc_balle_de_pioche: Activates right away on the next 4 individual races (2 men's, 2 women's): 4 biathletes instead of 3, your best 3 count.
BonusCards.desc_aspiration: Keep it in hand: on an individual race of your choice, each of your biathletes counts one place higher (an 11th becomes 10th and scores).
BonusCards.desc_equipe: Activates right away until the end of the season: each biathlete of your favourite team in the Top 10 (or your nation in the relay Top 10) earns you their odds once more, whether you picked them or not.
BonusCards.desc_fusee: Play it on a stage before its 1st race: in all its individual races, +100 pts per picked biathlete with the fastest ski time, +50 for the 2nd, +20 for the 3rd. Even outside the Top 10.
BonusCards.desc_gachette: Play it on a stage before its 1st race: in all its individual races, +100 pts per picked biathlete who shoots 20/20 (+50 for a 10/10 in the sprint). Even outside the Top 10.
BonusCards.desc_talent: One of your Hidden Diamonds has been revealed? Reactivate it (it becomes hidden again and scores on its next Top 10) or pick a new one, for the men or for the women.
BonusCards.talentPlayHint: Talent card: reactivate or change your Diamond
BonusCards.stagePlayNone: No upcoming stage to play it on (not at the Worlds/Olympics, nor with Boost).
BonusCards.stagePlayError: The card couldn't be played. Try again.
